description: List Sejm prints (druki sejmowe: the numbered documents the Sejm works on, such as bills, committee reports and opinions) with number, title, dates and attachment file names. A bill's print number also identifies its legislative process (get-process).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 50

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. documentDate; prefix with - for descending order (e.g. -changeDate for the most recently changed)

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-prints

attachments.description: File names of the attachments (usually PDF and DOCX)

processPrint.description: Prints that started the legislative processes this print belongs to

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: List prints
